signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against outside zone plays.
Defenders with this ability are refunded a pass rush point when they successfully shed blocks
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful stiff arm animations.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Locker room pep talks go a long way. Players with this ability can easily enter the Zone in the 2nd half.
The game's top defenders excel in all situations. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance of defeating run blocks, and disrupting catches via tackles.
Defenders with this ability have better conservative/dive tackling, are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves, and cannot be faked out when user-controlled.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Defenders with this ability can make jumping, 180-degree interceptions while lurking in a zone in the middle of the field.
Defenders with this ability don't allow broken tackles when hit-sticking ballcarriers - regardless of the runner's size or power.
